verdict.rationale: Devin documents a public API for integrating it into applications and automating workflows, including creating sessions on behalf of org users (create_as_user_id). The llms.txt index lists a large API documentation section. The official Devin MCP server adds programmatic session, playbook, knowledge and schedule management. missing for 10: endpoint-level detail in the evidence, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), independent or hands-on corroboration of API usage.
